skillTree.localised_description: It never hurts to keep your lucky Gnoblar with you, just in case.
Stumpy and short-witted as they are, these Gnoblars have an eye on the sky at all times.
Puny magicks are nothing in the face of the Great Maw's endless hunger.

Big boat ride started nice, full o’ meat and shiny loot, till the ground we camped on started movin’. Turned out it weren’t land but a giant sea-beast, and it weren’t happy we lit a fire on its back. Most got tossed into the drink, but Sandbad clung to driftwood, washed up hungry, and found a new place to plunder.

skillTree.localised_description: The desert sun was too hot, so Sanbad hired a gaggle of flying beasts – Blood Vultures, fast enough to carry a feast. Good travel, till the flapping things got greedy and tried to snack on his plunder. Sanbad taught 'em a lesson with his cleaver, and now they listen, flying tighter and tougher, willing to take a shot for the boss if it means they don't get eaten themselves.

effects.description:
Campaign line of sight: +33%
	(all units in army)

Melee defence: +8 for Blood Vultures and Dune Vultures units
	(all units in army)

Missile resistance: 20% for Blood Vultures and Dune Vultures units
	(all units in army)

skillTree.localised_description: The desert wasn't done with Sanbad. He spent a moon trapped in a valley where massive, hungry Giants were being pelted with rocks by pesky mountain tribes. Sanbad saw an opportunity—he taught the big lads to tough out the stony rain, and how to make the ground itself an angry beast. Now, when the Giants move, the earth shakes and spits back at their enemies, a proper lesson on who owns the mountain.

effects.description:
Passive ability: "Big Stomp" for Giants
	(all units in army)

Missile resistance: 20% for Giants
	(all units in army)

skillTree.localised_description: The best voyages always end with the biggest feast. Sanbad sailed into a land of soft-bellied merchants and found they cared more for their shiny silver than their stock of meat. A quick 'negotiation' with his cleaver taught them proper trade etiquette. Now, after every scrap, the bounty is twice as heavy, and the butchers gladly deliver more, knowing that a full Sanbad is a predictable Sanbad.

After too long living on the rolling waves, Sanbad decided a proper home was due, if only for a few months. He found a place with tough stone and soft workers, but the local Gnoblar builders took forever to finish a simple meat-shed. Sanbad taught them a lesson in efficiency with his big foot and an even bigger cleaver: work twice as fast, or become dinner. Now, his command makes stone leap into place and walls rise in a fraction of the time.

effects.description:
Construction cost: -15% for Province Capital/Settlement buildings
	(local region)

Construction time: -1 for Province Capital/Settlement buildings
	(local region)

skillTree.localised_description: Sanbad once found a bustling port city, rich with exotic goods but plagued by greedy tariffs and lazy merchants. A few "friendly" demonstrations of his strength and a clever rearrangement of their tax ledgers—with a cleaver, of course—and suddenly, the gold flowed like fresh gravy. Now, in any port he graces, the docks hum with prosperity, and the trade winds carry not just ships, but overflowing coffers for his entire faction.

effects.description: Income from Pottery, Dye and Salt industry: +20%

skillTree.localised_description: The undead stink of rot, whether from ancient tombs or briny deeps, always sets Sanbad’s teeth on edge. One time, he stumbled into a cursed land, full of whispering ghouls and rattling bones. They thought a single Ogre was an easy meal. Sanbad showed them what a real nightmare tastes like. His cleaver sang through withered flesh and splintered bone, each swing a promise of permanent oblivion to those already dead. Now, when the walking dead rise, Sanbad fights with a furious glee, knowing they make for the most satisfying kind of kindling.

skillTree.localised_description: This Tyrant is the size of several large creatures rolled into one. In fact, he ate those several large creatures just yesterday.
A Bellower’s voice is as deep as it loud, carrying across the battlefield and encouraging unbridled carnage.
"Da Wanderer, they call 'im da Wanderer – 'e roams around, around, around, around, around."

skillTree.localised_description: Being a Bruiser is simple: be bigger and stronger than everyone else, and smack seven shades of dung out of other Ogres to remind any would-be challenger who is boss.
No enemy is immovable when in the path of a furious Ogre's charge.
This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.
This Ogre's greed shall never be sated, for his stomach is as endless as his hunger.
A truly sturdy armour is needed to hold such an overflowing gut in place.
Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.
From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.
If the enormous size of this Ogre doesn't incite terror, his bloody, malevolent smile surely will.

related_attributes.bullet_text: This unit can cause terror, making its melee target rout for a short time. Units that cause terror are immune to terror and fear themselves.

skillTree.localised_description: The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.
Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.
Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.
Spellcasters can oft-sense when magic is close or being drawn from the Winds.

backgroundSkills.localised_description: Before Sandbad's adventurous life truly started he was a bodyguard to Arabyan Sheik who was wealthy merchant, both traveled a lot together, well until said sheik's coin run out dry by an unlucky bet
